rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At a farewell banquet in his honour hosted by President Thabo Mbeki in Pretoria on 16 June 1999, Mandela says the election date meant 'that we should inaugurate our new President on our national Youth Day', speaks of 'the passing of the baton from one President to another' at 'this installation', and welcomes 'the new status I have occupied since this morning' as 'an ordinary citizen'.

locator.section: Heading and '(CHECK AGAINST DELIVERY)' marking; paragraph 1; paragraph beginning 'Today a worthy son'; paragraph beginning 'The warmth I have experienced today' and the next; closing 'Issued by the Office of the President, 16 June 1999'

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same release is headed as a banquet 'HOSTED BY PRESIDENT THABO MBEKI', opens its salutation with 'President Mbeki' and welcomes 'our new President, Thabo Mbeki'.

locator.section: Heading; salutation; paragraph beginning 'It is also a matter of great pride'
